name: Motion carousel
route: No live route — pre-auth brand carousel between Splash [01] and Welcome sign-up [03].
annotation: HIFI-02 · no live route · dark shell (Splash-matching cinematic ground) + top-center amber radial glow, full-bleed MotionStage hero, single Tiempos italic emphasis on "life".

modules.build: StatusBar default — time/signal/battery, dark-shell ink styling over the amber-radial atmosphere. No CIA badge: pre-auth brand carousel has no personalized read to surface.
BtnGhost "skip" top-right, 44px hit area + visible focus ring. No back arrow — first pre-auth screen after Splash [01]; skip exits straight to Welcome sign-up [03].

MotionStage, full-bleed panel-1 viewport, no card frame: continuous stroke draws through nine domain dots over 1200ms, then rests with a subtle pulse. ChipProvenance shows the bundled Rive/Lottie asset-version; ChipDomainTag marks each life-domain dot as an identity mark, not chrome. Skeleton: warm shimmer geometry, not blank gray.
Centered copy, 2 lines max: "One life, not modules." (Display, Tiempos italic on "life") / "Everything connects. Finally." (Body subtext). Current slide announced to screen readers as "Slide 1 of 4."
Progress bar + 3 dots below copy, index 1 of 4 active, native paging physics. Pagination is decorative and paired with the screen-reader slide announcement, not a separate visible caption.

BtnPrimary "next", orange fill, locked width, spinner if navigation exceeds 400ms. On panel 4 label swaps to "Get started"; press crossfades CTA glow to --glow-done before pushing [03]. Disabled only during handoff, screen-reader reason "Opening sign-up."
HomeIndicator, system default, dark-shell styling. No floating tab nav — pre-auth brand carousel has no Today/CIA/Goals/Me tabs; the single BtnPrimary plus "skip" ghost are the only actions.

imageSlots: HIFI-02-01 — above-fold brand-motion viewport; privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text, no identifiable face/body/home/document.
trustControls: ChipProvenance — bundled Rive/Lottie asset-version shown on the motion stage; real, not decorative.
Panel 3 CIAInsightCard — demo-provenance chip labeled "demo"; never shown as personal data; omitted entirely (honest-null) rather than inventing a personalized correlation.
Panel 4 quest card honest-null — "XP unlocks after sign-up." when no demo count-up runs; XP counter otherwise labeled "sample", with no count-up if playback support is uncertain.
Consent-gated media — no identifiable face, body, home, document, or provider logo appears without explicit permission.
ErrorState — appears only after repeated asset failure; "skip" and "Get started" remain usable throughout.
notes: Shell corrected to DARK: though 02 sits in the auth-family numbering (default assumption warm-light per batch convention), this spec's own Visual System section explicitly commits to "Warm dark base #0A0A0F, top-center amber radial glow, and 3-4 percent grain" — identical wording to Splash [01]'s spec — the spec-declared override wins per source hierarchy; 02, like 01, 03c (consent), 06 (guest preview), and 65 (force update), is a cinematic/system brand moment rather than an input form, so the warm-light auth default doesn't apply. Italic word resolved to "life" (from the primary Panel-1 headline "One life, not modules.") rather than the Visual System's generic "*carousel*" placeholder, which is just the screen's file-slug and never appears as literal rendered copy anywhere in the spec — consistent with how sibling packets resolved "look" over "preview" (06) and "begin" over "consent" (03c). Off-canvas panels are native horizontal paging, not vertical overflow, so they are documented here rather than modularized as separate build slots (keeping the 8-module cap on the default/current-slide render): Panel 2 "Meet CIA, your coach." (purple CIA presence bloom); Panel 3 "Everything connects." (correlation-line pulse once, then CIAInsightCard fades up with evidence chips, demo-provenance, honest-null omission if no example pattern exists); Panel 4 "Your life, gamified." (XP ProgressRing fills to sample progress, then quest card settles, honest-null "XP unlocks after sign-up." when no count-up runs). Reduced-motion: disables stroke draw, CIA bloom, correlation pulse, and XP count-up — every panel loads as a final still with opacity-only transitions. Accessibility: paper text on #0A0A0F/#211008 meets AA+; inactive pagination dots are decorative, paired with the SR slide announcement, not a separate caption; "skip", CTA, and pager affordances hold 44px touch targets. No overflow past y844 — belowFold=[]. imageSlots=[HIFI-02-01] per spec's Image Slots section.
